method: Root visually inspected these exact R4 emulator screenshots. Independent overlay review also found no alignment blocker. Gameplay and performance claims are bound separately to native reports.

limitations: The emulator's pre-existing black terrain issue remains in Normal/SwiftShader. Ground textures and the appearance of slopes could not be visually approved; native terrain picks, heights, positions and completion were checked.
Physical Android devices were not tested in this task.

All 161 ordinary catalogue types were exercised through the actual JavaScript renderer and 1,932 native source geometry cases. Real emulator construction covered representative 1x1, 2x2 and 1x2 structures, elevated sites and Research/Power/Factory modules; it did not construct every catalogue type or certify all 30 waves.
Native automatic wall-variant model choice is not published by the scripting API. Preview metadata retains the original selected structure model.
